title: Project Coordination Standards: Permits and Scheduling of Replacement System Installations
content:
# Permits and scheduling — Replacement System Installations

## Standards

**S1.** A project is scheduled once its permit is pulled; scheduling books the installation day.

**S2.** The installation day may be no earlier than the package's equipment lead time (in business days) after the in-home cancellation period ends, or after the signing date for a showroom, phone or web contract. Business days here are Monday through Friday, except federal public holidays.

**S3.** A financed project is scheduled only once its financing account is approved.

**S4.** A project whose financing is declined, withdrawn or expired is scheduled only after the homeowner pays the deposit required of an unfinanced project or arranges other approved financing.

**S5.** The crew needs the package's crew days on site, counted in working days.

**S6.** The permit fee posts when the project is scheduled.

## Basis of judgement

Whether a financed project's financing account is approved is read from the Home Comfort Financing account linked to the project, as the system records it.

## Financing and scheduling

| Project financing | Financing account status | Scheduled |
|---|---|---|
| Not financed | — | Subject to S1 and S2 |
| Financed | Approved | Subject to S1 and S2 |
| Financed | Not yet approved | Not yet |
| Financing declined, withdrawn or expired | — | Only after the unfinanced deposit is paid or other approved financing is arranged |

## Earliest installation day (hypothetical contracts, no federal public holiday in the count)

- An in-home contract whose cancellation period ends on a Thursday, on a package with a 2 business-day lead time: Friday is business day 1 and Monday is business day 2, so the earliest installation day is that Monday.
- A showroom contract signed on a Wednesday, on a package with a 3 business-day lead time: Thursday (1), Friday (2), Monday (3), so the earliest installation day is that Monday.
- Saturdays and Sundays are not business days for this count.
